outputs.explanation: Panel A includes three bar charts (nuclear, cytosolic, mitochondrial fraction quantifications) showing mean ± SD with N=4 replicates, but only bars with error bars are shown; no individual data points are overlaid on the bars.
Panel B is an immunoelectron micrograph, not a plot of averaged data, so individual data points are not applicable.
Panel C is a western blot image showing bands from different purification methods; it is not a plot of averaged data.
Panel D is a western blot showing protein levels under different proteinase K/membrane perforation conditions; it is not a plot of averaged data.
